summary: Find a credible network path and prepare a considerate, permission-aware introduction.

useCases.title: Make a thoughtful warm introduction
useCases.message: Find the strongest credible path between these people, explain the relationship evidence and sensitivity, and prepare the right introduction or intermediary ask for review.

useCases.title: Find and prepare a useful introduction
useCases.message: Use my approved network and relationship context to find a credible path between these people, then prepare a considerate introduction without overstating the relationship or sharing private deal context.

useCases.title: Make a useful warm introduction
useCases.message: Help me connect these people thoughtfully. Verify the relationship path, protect private context, and draft the appropriate ask or introduction for review.

useCases.title: Find a credible path into an account
useCases.message: Find a credible relationship path into this account and prepare a respectful intermediary ask or warm introduction for review.

useCases.title: Prepare a warm candidate introduction
useCases.message: Help me find and verify a credible path to this person, then prepare a respectful introduction or referral ask without exposing private candidate context.
